# Vendored: OodleSharp

`OodleDecompressor.cs` is copied unchanged from https://github.com/NotOfficer/OodleSharp
(`src/OodleSharp/OodleDecompressor.cs`) at commit `716d8b9ce3bd74ece37097d2b5e5ef67ef0c48c5` (2026-06-04),
under the MIT license in `LICENSE` next to this file.

It is a pure managed Oodle decoder (its header says it was machine-ported from the Oodle SDK).
Phase 0 verified it on Minecraft Dungeons II 1.1.1.0 (Xbox): every hero texture package decompresses
to its exact expected size. No RAD Game Tools binaries are bundled.
